q: Naive extraction of a two-column PDF often produces what problem?
options: Lines from both columns interleaved into nonsense

q: When is a vision-language model worth its cost for parsing?
options: For hard pages such as scans, complex tables, charts and handwriting
explain: Route by difficulty; use cheaper extraction elsewhere.

q: Why keep page numbers and section paths as metadata?

They are required by vector databases
